protocol: Leave one existing training source out; fit vocabulary and classifier from scratch on other training sources. Fixed prior hyperparameters.
metric_policy: Macro F1 always uses all seven labels, including classes absent from an individual evaluation source. Pooled metrics weight rows, not sources.

checks: All 598 training rows evaluated exactly once; no val/test rows included
Nine saved models reproduce all internal predictions
Vocabulary terms and IDF values agree with fit rows only in every fold
Every source disjoint between fitting and evaluation
Per-source metrics and fold-specific majority baseline independently recalculated
Frozen evaluation hash unchanged; changes to holdout content do not alter internal folds

prediction_text_hash_encoding: The text_sha256 in predictions.json is fingerprint(text): SHA-256 of the canonical JSON string, not raw UTF-8 text.

interpretation.conclusion: Limited transfer to excluded training sources, especially ideas and colonial context. Performance varies across sources; no single cause established.
interpretation.comparison_with_previous_validation: Not comparable as a before/after improvement: different evaluation rows, nine fits instead of one, internal training-source diagnostic.

limits: Fixed settings were previously selected using the original validation; this is a diagnostic, not an unbiased final performance estimate.
All data and annotations have already been inspected or revised; no fresh human-validated external test.
Only nine source groups, including groups of two and four examples; do not rank source quality from accuracy.
Pooled metrics weight individual rows, so Basadre has 244/598 of the evaluation weight.
Per-fold macro F1 includes all seven labels, even absent classes; per-source accuracy and class support are shown for interpretation.
The majority baseline is deliberately simple and performs poorly under these source/class distributions; beating it does not establish usability.
Known same-source duplicate remains within one source group and affects row weighting.
No new val/test predictions, hyperparameter search, BETO training, remote calls or deployment.
next_step: Compare word versus character text representations using the same internal source folds, fixed classifier settings and a documented comparison protocol; keep frozen validation/test untouched in that block.
